THE_FINDING_the_band_factor_has_NO_SINGL.why_they_differ: Different OBJECT (pre-extraction R_push vs extracted cross-section ratio), different CELL SET (84 geometric vs 63 quotable vs 257 domain), different pT RANGE (all rows vs 0-9), different AGGREGATION (mean vs median, per-cell vs per-column).
THE_FINDING_the_band_factor_has_NO_SINGL.consequence: Three independent lanes produced three different per-column profiles and none was wrong. This is the definite-description problem at the level of a NUMBER: 'the band factor' re-points depending on object, cell set and aggregation. Any quotation of it must name all four.
THE_FINDING_the_band_factor_has_NO_SINGL.class: same family as the C_stat symbol collision (00b4cb01) and the cv-is-the-replica-mean trap (68d9104d)

WHAT_STANDS: The corrections in 68d9104d stand: the sparsity amplifier is narrowed not refuted, and the sign reversal was over-weighted by this lane.
The >20 GeV region is a SATURATION rather than a clean sign flip, and it is family-level. My retraction of that was the error, not the original claim.
No PET covariance is adopted. The 2026-08-20 ruling is not reopened.
